items.title: Alphabet股價下跌10%，該公司維持2026年資本支出不變，預計2027年將大幅成長。

items.titleZh: Alphabet股價下跌10%，該公司維持2026年資本支出不變，預計2027年將大幅成長。
items.summaryEn: Alphabet missed Q3 expectations on earnings and revenue, its first top-and-bottom-line miss in nearly four years.
items.summaryZh: Alphabet 第三季獲利和營收都未達預期，這是該公司近四年來首次營收和獲利雙雙不及預期。

items.summaryEn: The economy is still a key issue in the 2026 election, but voters are concerned about Trump testing the bounds of the office and Democratic Socialist polices.
